name: camellia sinensis leaf + centella asiatica leaf
purpose: Purpose 1. An easy-to-use sunscreen stick provides portable and easy protection against strong ultraviolet rays with just a few light sweeps! 2. Moisturizing sunscreen stick is a multifunctional product that doubles as a moisturizer and sunscreen. This formula combines nourishing and moisturizing plant extracts to lock in moisture, keep the skin soft and smooth,and provide sufficient sun protection.
uses: 1. Open the transparent cover of the product, gently. Rotate the bottom shaft, and roll out the rod. 2. Gently and evenly apply to the surface of the skin.
